title: Hold It All Together
note: Banked hold-out (song 65). Disco-funk; lead words only; the backing singers' answers in brackets in lyric_locked.md. Not run: no room check, no build.
sections: Verse 1
When the old TV goes to snow between the shows
Some of that's the morning of the world, fourteen billion years ago
A heartbeat in perfect time is a heartbeat running down
You put the swing in it, and in every living sound
Pre-chorus 1
Everything I see and the things I never see
Every king on a throne and the powers that be
All of it leans your way like a crowd leans into the bass
Most of them can't name you but they all know the place
Chorus 1
You hold it all together
When I'm coming apart, you're the tether
Before the band, before the room, before the weather
You were here, and you hold it all together
Verse 2
You're the picture of a face nobody's seen
You were first of everything that's ever been
You keep on talking and the whole room hears
From the hum of the stars to the drum in my ears
Pre-chorus 2
Everything I see and the things I never see
Every king on a throne and the powers that be
All of it leans your way like a crowd leans into the bass
Most of them can't name you but they all know the place
Chorus 2
You hold it all together
When I'm coming apart, you're the tether
Before the band, before the room, before the weather
You were here, and you hold it all together
Bridge
The spiral arms way out past the moon
The quarks in a grain of sand
The girl in the corner who thinks no one sees her
You've got her by the hand
Chorus 3
You hold it all together
When I'm coming apart, you're the tether
Before the band, before the room, before the weather
You were here, and you hold it all together
Tag
You hold it all together
